name: New Bough
description: A sword made from sacred wood, said to have once turned the tide of battle.
passive_desc: When the equipping character hits the opponent with an attack within 12s after using the Elemental Skill, they gain the "Verdant" effect, which increases their ATK by 4% and their Elemental Mastery by 20. This effect lasts 6s and can trigger once every second. Max 3 stacks. The aforementioned effects can still trigger even when the equipping character is not on the field.\nRadiance: Stellar Glimmer: The effect of "Verdant" is changed to: Increases ATK by 6% as well as Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt by the equipping character by 8%.
